decisions.text: type bar: categories compared by value
nominal categories sorted by value, descending
every name fits under its bar, neighbours at least 10 pt apart: vertical bars
4 values against 5 scale labels: whichever puts fewer numbers on the chart (G2.18): the values labelled directly, the value scale and its gridlines removed, the zero line kept as the baseline
value labels as a set, one magnitude and one number of decimals, the prefix and suffix on each: £3.40, £2.80, £2.35, £1.95 (G6.16, G7.4)
every label just outside its bar's end: neither the text grey nor white reads on the bar's colour at 4.5 : 1 (G7.4, G6.5)
the unit's description on its own line above the plot: “average single fare”; the labels carry its prefix, suffix and magnitude

source.shows: amounts of money that need pence take two decimals throughout the set: value labels £3.40, £2.80 (never £3.4); the variant, child fares on a scale by 0.50, reads 0.00 … £2.00 (G6.16, G2.24)
